justification: JSN and Golden are both bye-week ghosts this week, zero on the board and no game to even watch, so they're benched without a second thought - no offense to either, I just can't fancy a fella who isn't even playing. Carnell Tate's got that rookie bounce I called out the day I claimed him and Adonai Mitchell's still the gorgeous highlight that made me spend FAAB on him, Questionable tag or not, I don't read injury reports, I read tape, so both of them start at WR. Everything else stays exactly as it was because it's working - Purdy's slinging it, Cook and McCaffrey are the best backfield in the building after that 44-point explosion last week, Nabers is in the flex because he's gorgeous even on a quiet line, and Gesicki keeps the TE spot over Waller's Questionable tag because I'm not overthinking a tight end slot on a Wednesday. Lisa's bringing a backfield triage unit and a borrowed quarterback into this one - good luck with that, hun.
